# Harjinder Tourist Dhaba

Welcome to the Harjinder Tourist Dhaba website. This is an authentic Punjabi restaurant located on the Kharar–Kurali Highway (NH-24), Mohali, Punjab, India. 
We have been serving fresh, traditional Punjabi food since 1991. We are open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

## Navigation & Structure
This is a single-page application built with React. The main sections are:
- /#home : The hero section and introduction.
- /#menu : The digital food menu, categorized into North Indian, Chinese, Tandoor, and Beverages.
- /#banquet : Information about booking our Party Hall for events.
- /#about : Our history and amenities.

## Interactive Features
- The menu features an interactive shopping cart. Users can add items, select variants (Half/Full, With/Without Butter), and proceed to a checkout view.
- The site provides direct WhatsApp ordering functionality when the cart is submitted.
